GeoTOP as a BimDataFrame

The downloaded voxels in a bimpolars BimDataFrame, one row per voxel: a box mesh in GeoTOP's lithology color, the stratigraphic unit as class, and the voxel's GeoTOP values in the property set GeoTOP. It is written to data/geotop_bimdf.parquet for the next notebooks, and rebuilt whenever a download replaces data/geotop.nc.
